name: Yui
source:
One of the four people with the special abilities from the Setou Underground Science Institution, a beautiful silver-haired girl. 
She always looks anguished. She had never seen the world outside the laboratory, so she dreams about escaping it one day...

[Roughly translated from [url=http://cla.velvet.jp/kasou1.htm]the official site[/url].]
